טיפים שקשורים לרצפת האגן לתקופה שלאחר הל: Pelvic floor tips for the period after birth
תקופת ההריון היא תקופה משמעותית מבחינת ה: Pregnancy is a significant period in terms of its effect on the abdominal and pelvic floor muscles. During this time, the pelvic floor and the abdominal wall are weakened by the pregnancy itself (the added mechanical load of the weight of the uterus and its contents, which the pelvic floor and abdomen have to carry) and by the presence of progesterone and relaxin = hormones whose job is to "soften" soft tissues, so that the tissues of the abdominal wall can "contain" the pregnancy and, when the time comes, the baby can pass through the pelvic floor. The connective tissues of the pelvic floor and the abdominal wall stretch, and may also tear (torn connective tissue can only be repaired surgically, if at all). In addition, the pressure on the pelvic floor nerves in the late stages of pregnancy, as they are squeezed between the baby's head and the mother's pelvic bone, causes them some damage that keeps them from returning to their original state (as before a first pregnancy and birth). The "rule" for the pelvic floor and the abdominal wall: the more pregnancies a woman has, with bigger babies, and the longer or more interventional the births (vacuum / forceps) – the greater the chance of pelvic floor damage.
כאבי הגב בהריון נובעים מכמה סיבות (כולן: Back pain in pregnancy has several causes (all together): 1. The body's center of gravity shifts because of the growing belly – more load falls on the spine. 2. In the background – hormones that soften all the ligaments and tissues in the body, so the supporting tissues are more flexible and give less stability. 3. The pelvic joints can also refer pain, which sometimes seems to come from the back (but really comes from the pelvic joints) – there too, this happens because of excess movement in joints that normally do not move much, against the background of the tissue-softening hormones. 4. The muscles of the stabilizing system (the abdominal and pelvic floor muscles) are weaker than their norm because they are not at their physiological length, and they too "enjoy" the softening hormones. As for pain that comes from the pelvic joints – the source of the pain is excess flexibility in the pelvic joints caused by the pregnancy hormones (relaxin and progesterone), whose job is to soften all the body's tissues to make room to "contain" the pregnancy (everything is pushed aside, the tissues stretch and so on). These hormones (which do not distinguish between the connective tissue of the abdomen and, say, the ligaments that stabilize the ankle…) also soften the pelvic joints (with good intentions… because then the pelvis can widen during birth and give the baby's head more room). This pain is very common among pregnant women, even from the very start of pregnancy (because the hormones are released from the very start). The excess mobility in the joints puts more strain on the ligaments that stabilize the joint, and these cause a lot of pain, which can sometimes even radiate along the whole leg and mislead us into thinking it is a herniated disc or something similar. Pelvic joint pain has no consequences for the course of the birth, except that there is sometimes more sensitivity after the birth, but it heals slowly after the birth.
מה לעשות כדי לעזור לכאב באזור האגן והגב: What can help with pelvic and back pain during pregnancy?
קיימות טכניקות של הפיזיותרפיה לטיפול במפ: There are physiotherapy techniques for treating the pelvic joints during pregnancy (this is an individual treatment). These techniques encourage the muscular system that supports the pelvic joints, and can bring significant relief. Other things that can help: a pelvic belt. In daily behavior: avoid (as far as possible) actions that put shearing forces on the pelvic joints – actions with one leg here and one leg there, such as climbing stairs; sleep with a pillow between your legs (it reduces the load on the pelvic joints). In cases of very severe pain, when getting around (walking) is really difficult, a walker may be considered to take the load off the joints, or in very, very severe cases even a wheelchair for getting around.
כאבים בעצם החיק (פוביס סימפיסיס) \\ סימפ: Pain in the pubic bone (pubic symphysis) / symphysiolysis
סימפיזיוליזיס היא תנועתיות יתר במפרק הסי: Symphysiolysis is excess mobility of the pubic symphysis, the front joint of the pelvic ring, caused by the pregnancy hormones (relaxin and progesterone), which soften the ligaments and tissues that stabilize the joint (and all the other joints in the body too). This pain in the groin, or pain in the back pelvic joints, is very common during pregnancy. The guidance for easing the pain appears under "Pain in the pelvic joints and back".
האם חיזוק של שרירי האגן עוד לפני כניסה ל: Does strengthening my pelvic muscles before getting pregnant guarantee I won't have urinary incontinence and other problems?
את רצפת האגן צריך לתרגל בתרגול יומיומי,: The pelvic floor should be exercised every day, all your life, regardless of pregnancy. Strengthening the pelvic floor before pregnancy does not give you an "insurance policy" against problems. But if you are aware of your pelvic floor and exercise it, you will arrive with more skilled and stronger muscles, so even if it weakens, at least your starting point was better. A woman who exercises routinely finds it easier to recognize the muscle's action and to start exercising it again with relative ease after the birth. Pelvic floor strength also helps the birth itself, because the baby makes its internal rotation on the inner muscle layer on its way out, and if this muscle layer is weak and slack, the baby will find it harder to do this and may need interventional help (vacuum, forceps).
האם יש טעם לפנות לטיפול פיזיותרפי גם בשב: Is it worth coming for physiotherapy even late in pregnancy?
אין בעיה עקרונית בתרגול של רצפת האגן ושר: In principle there is no problem with exercising the pelvic floor and postural muscles during pregnancy – <u>quite the opposite</u>: during pregnancy and around the birth it is very important, because of the weakening the pelvic floor goes through under the influence of the pregnancy hormones and of the birth itself. Of course, if for some reason your doctor has forbidden exercise (rare), follow their instructions. The earlier you learn to recognize and work with the muscles, the better – because after the birth the area will weaken significantly further, and as a rule, the weaker the muscles you bring to rehabilitation, the harder they are to rehabilitate. You will also get guidance on a healthy lifestyle and correct use of the body, to immediately reduce damage you may be causing your body (for example, straining on the toilet), as well as guidance in preparing for birth – teaching you all the movements and positions whose aim, among other things, is to protect the pelvic floor during birth.
דליפת שתן וחולשת רצפת האגן בהריון: Urinary leakage and pelvic floor weakness in pregnancy
אירועים של בריחת שתן בסיטואציות של הריון: Urinary leakage during pregnancy and after birth is not rare, and sadly it is even quite common. What is even more common, and even sadder, is that women are embarrassed to raise it with their doctor, and sometimes, even when they do, they are not referred for treatment of the root of the problem. First, it is important to understand that the pelvic floor is already weakened by the p-r-e-g-n-a-n-c-y itself, for two main reasons. One: the presence of progesterone and relaxin – hormones whose job is to "soften" soft tissues (among other things, so that when the time comes the baby can pass through the pelvic floor). Progesterone is present afterwards too – during breastfeeding – so women who breastfeed are exposed to its effects for longer (this does not mean, heaven forbid, that you should not breastfeed, but be aware that the pelvic floor needs more attention while you are breastfeeding). It is true that the situation often "improves" after birth, but this is usually because of the different hormonal balance in the body, not because the root of the problem was treated by strengthening the pelvic floor. The second reason: the mechanical load (the weight of the pregnancy) on the pelvic floor. – So mothers who give birth by "cesarean" are not completely exempt either… And of course, afterwards each birth adds its own "contribution" to the cumulative damage.
עיסוי פרינאום – כדי שתושג יעילות בעיסוי: Perineal massage – for perineal massage to be effective (effective = widening the perineum so that the chance of a perineal cut during birth is reduced), you need an effective stretch that works on the collagen component of the muscle tissue. Such a stretch is hard to achieve with home massage, where the partner does the stretching for the mother, because most people who are not professionals find it hard to feel where the limit of the stretch is, and so on. Also, some men shy away from the somewhat gynecological "role" of being "the one who stretches" – unless the perineal massage comes as part of sexual play, in a good spirit that suits both partners. A mother trying to massage herself has a hard time, because she cannot truly relax: the position she needs to reach the area physically does not let her be relaxed. In short – not impossible, but complicated. My personal recommendation is the "Epi-No" device, which lets the mother work on her own, at her own pace, without depending on a partner; it works on a circumferential stretch (which cannot be achieved by hand); and (in my eyes this is the device's real strength) it lets the mother practice pushing correctly – that is, learn to relax the pelvic floor muscles together with the right timing of the transverse abdominal muscle, while something uncomfortable is in the vagina.
תרגול לקראת לידה עם מכשיר האפי-נו: Practicing for birth with the Epi-No device
מכשיר האפינו מסייע מאוד בלימוד ההרפיה וה: The Epi-No device helps a great deal in learning to relax and to push correctly. How do you work with the Epi-No? – Insert the Epi-No balloon into the vagina, inflated just a tiny bit (so that it is slightly firm). Inflate until you feel a s-t-r-e-t-c-h, but n-o (!) pain and n-o (!) burning. Leave it for about 3 minutes, practicing relaxation during that time (because when there is something unpleasant in the vagina, the muscle responds with a protective contraction). After 3 minutes, inflate a little more, again until you feel a stretch but no burning and no pain, and so learn to relax (when you relax, you see the pressure drop on the pressure gauge). After another 3 minutes, inflate a little again until you feel a stretch, and finally practice pushing the balloon out while relaxing, and while giving the balloon counter-support with your hand (because the moment it starts to move, the protective contraction against the discomfort will come again). In this way you bring it out very gradually, keeping the pelvic floor relaxed, breathing out, and pushing with the transverse abdominal muscle.
אפינו כאמצעי עזר לתרגול שרירי רצפת האגן: Epi-No as an aid for pelvic floor muscle exercise
אין שום בעיה להיעזר במכשיר האפי-נו לתרגו: There is no problem at all with using the Epi-No to exercise the pelvic floor; on the contrary, it can be a helpful aid (this refers to the device with the pressure gauge). It is just important to make sure first that you really know which contraction is meant. This is especially true if your pelvic floor muscles are already weak, since then their action is harder to recognize, and it is also best to allow longer rests between contractions and between sessions, which suits training a weak muscle better. Why is it important to know how to recognize it? – So as not to get the action wrong and push outward instead of contracting (the Epi-No responds and shows a rise in pressure even when you do the wrong action).
במהלך הלידה, חשופה רצפת האגן ללחץ ומתיחה: During birth the pelvic floor is exposed to significant pressure and stretching. Sometimes spontaneous tears or a deliberate cut (episiotomy) are added, which make it lose even more of its strength. The postpartum period, and even several months after it, which make up the pelvic floor's recovery time from pregnancy and birth, are critically important for a woman's uro-gynecological future. The postpartum period is usually taken to be 6 weeks after the birth, but in practice the recovery time of the various pelvic floor tissues is much longer. The literature today speaks of about two months of recovery for the nerve, three months of recovery for the muscle, and about another four to six months
דגשים לגבי החזרה לפעילות אחרי הלידה:: Key points about returning to activity after the birth:
תרגילים לרצפת האגן מיד לאחר הלידה: Pelvic floor exercises right after birth
להימנע ככל שניתן מלחיצה בזמן מתן שתן או: Avoid straining when passing urine or stool as far as possible. To ease pelvic floor pain when passing urine or stool (because of stitches and so on), you can support the pelvic floor tissues with the palm of your hand (with toilet paper or a clean cloth on it).
להתחיל בתרגול והפעלה של שרירי רצפת האגן: Start exercising and using the pelvic floor muscles right after the birth: contract the muscles while breathing out, as a first step before any effort you make (coughing, sneezing, lifting things or the baby and so on), and when you return to exercise, let the pelvic floor "set the pace" – that is, if during an exercise you feel the pelvic floor cannot stay contracted, stop the exercise. Recovery of the connective tissues (in women who breastfeed this takes even longer, because of the presence of progesterone in the body).
חזרה לקיום יחסי מין לאחר הלידה: Returning to sex after the birth
בתקופה שלאחר הלידה, על רקע רמות נמוכות ש: In the period after birth, because of low estrogen levels, sexual arousal takes longer: engorgement of the labia and vagina is slower, and the vagina is less lubricated. As long as the woman is breastfeeding this stays relevant, and on top of it comes a suppression of sexual desire because of the hormone oxytocin, which is released during breastfeeding and creates a feeling of calm and suppresses desire. Besides the low estrogen levels, there are sometimes also "souvenirs" of the birth: scars that healed with adhesions to nearby tissues, or healed prominently. When there is pelvic floor pain, the pelvic floor muscles respond with a protective contraction – which can make the pain worse because there is more friction, and can even make penetration really difficult. Pain during sex can be helped with lubricants such as KY gel (sold at any pharmacy or sex shop). When there is pain from problematic scarring of the stitches, or a muscle contraction that does not allow penetration, physiotherapy techniques can help release and soften scars and relax the muscles. Vaginal widening after birth may come from weakened muscles and also from damage to the connective tissues (or both…). This feeling of widening should lessen with exercise and as the area recovers, assuming there was no massive damage to the connective tissues.
במצב בריחת שתן מיד אחרי הלידה: If there is urinary leakage right after the birth
כדאי לדעת כי ב<strong>רוב המקרים, איבוד: It is worth knowing that in most cases, a complete loss of control settles and improves within a few days. The reason you lose the ability to control urine right after the birth is the trauma that the nerves supplying the pelvic floor muscles go through during the birth (and of course, the longer the birth, with prolonged pushing and so on, the greater the damage). After the birth, each component of the pelvic floor begins to recover – the muscles, the nerves and the connective tissues. The less swollen and the more "active" the area (= using the muscles), the easier it is for the nerves to recover and for control to return. What to do in the meantime? a. Try to do pelvic floor contractions – you can try the stop test, and you can also try contracting the anus if that contraction is easier for you to recognize right now. b. Avoid straining on the toilet at all costs (do not pass stool or urine while straining). c. Avoid effort (as far as possible – do not lift heavy things, let others carry for you, and if you have to lift, try to contract the pelvic floor before and during the lift). d. Try to reduce swelling in the area, both with cold pads soaked in magnesium ("Epsom salt") and by trying to do contractions, which encourage the swelling to be absorbed, better blood flow and faster healing. e. Avoid sitting on a "swim ring" – (grandmothers used to bring a ring for the new mother so that she could sit without her pelvic floor touching the seat, to ease the pain of the stitches) – if the stitches hurt, sit on a soft but even surface = that is, do not leave the pelvic floor "hanging" in the air without support.
הקפידי במיוחד על התרגול והשימוש היומיומי: Be especially careful to exercise and use your pelvic floor every day.
הקפידי על קימה ושכיבה נכונות (דרך גלגול: Get up and lie down correctly (by rolling onto your side) to reduce the use of the long abdominal muscles.
<span class=\"t-factor__num\" aria-hidde: 03After the birth – start exercising the pelvic floor muscles. This will help the nerves recover faster, help the stitches heal faster and help absorb swelling from the area.
הימנעי מישיבה ממושכת בשירותים ובמיוחד מל: Avoid sitting on the toilet for long, and especially avoid straining (to pass urine or stool).
במצב של כאבים (בשל תפרים, בצקות וכיוב'): If you are in pain (from stitches, swelling and so on), sit on a soft, even surface (for example a cushion), not on a ring. If it is hard to pass urine or stool because of pain, use the palm of your hand, wrapped in toilet paper, to support the pelvic floor while emptying. This lets you empty with much less pain.
בתקופת משכב הלידה (6 שבועות ראשונים לאחר: During the postpartum period (the first 6 weeks after birth), avoid effort as much as you can, and if you do have to make an effort, be sure to contract the pelvic floor before and during it.
בתום 6 שבועות (8 שבועות לאחר ניתוח קיסרי: After 6 weeks (8 weeks after a cesarean) – return gradually to your usual physical activity, letting the pelvic floor "set" the pace of your return.
שיטת גיארם (A.P.E) ומנשפית WINNERFLOW |: The Guillarme Method (A.P.E) and the WINNERFLOW Exhaler | Sivan Navot
שיקום בטן ורצפת אגן בנשיפה בשיטת גיארם (: Abdominal and pelvic floor rehabilitation through exhalation with the Guillarme method (A.P.E) and the WINNERFLOW exhaler. Sivan Navot trained with Luc Guillarme, has taught the method in Israel since 2013 and imports the exhalers.
The Guillarme method, Abdo-Périnéo Expiratoire (A.P.E), is a French method for rehabilitating the abdomen and pelvic floor through exhalation. It was developed by the physiotherapist Luc Guillarme, who saw the diaphragm, the deep abdominal muscles and the pelvic floor as one functional unit, and set out to rehabilitate it through the breath rather than through forced, isolated muscle contraction.
התרגול נעשה בעזרת ה-WINNERFLOW, מנשפית ש: The exercises are done with the WINNERFLOW, an exhaler Guillarme developed in 1991. The exhaler regulates the outflow of air so the exhalation is even and active, and this exhalation naturally engages the diaphragm, the deep abdominal muscles and the pelvic floor, without harmful pressure inside the abdomen. In this way the body relearns the coordination between the breath, the abdomen and the pelvic floor. In my treatments I also add work with soft weights on the chest, which make it easier for the abdominal muscles to work against the diaphragm.
המנשפית היא גם כלי מצוין בלידה רגילה: הנ: The exhaler is also an excellent tool in vaginal birth: breathing out through it allows effective pushing in a relatively short time. In a randomized controlled trial published in 2023 in the Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology Canada (Dimassi et al.), the regulated-exhalation method significantly shortened the second stage of labor and the pushing time, and improved the women's birth experience. Read the article.
השיטה מתאימה לכל מצבי השיקום של הבטן, של: The method suits every kind of abdominal, pelvic floor and breathing rehabilitation:
למדתי את השיטה ב-2011 בפריז אצל לוק גיאר: I learned the method in 2011 in Paris from Luc Guillarme himself, and since then it has been a regular part of my clinical work. In 2013 he gave me written permission to present and teach it, and since that year I have been teaching the method in Israel to physiotherapists, midwives, fitness trainers and doulas. The method also suits speech therapists: the engine of the voice is the abdominal and pelvic floor muscles, which push the diaphragm upward to produce sound, and that is exactly what the exercises work on.
בשנים 2017 עד 2024 שימשה המנשפית גם במהל: From 2017 to 2024 the exhaler was also used during FAUCS cesarean sections, where it lets the mother produce the pushing force herself.
אני מייבאת לישראל את מנשפיות ה-WINNERFLO: I import the WINNERFLOW exhalers made by STIMED, the French manufacturer, to Israel. The exhalers are sold directly by me or through therapists I have trained in the method, and this is deliberate: correct guidance is hugely important when exercising with the exhaler. Mistakes are very common, especially among people with weak abdominal muscles or pelvic floor problems, and exercising incorrectly will not help, and may even cause harm. Fascial Manipulation® היא שיטת טיפול מנו: Fascial Manipulation® is a method of manual treatment of the fascia, the connective tissue that wraps and connects the muscles, organs and joints, developed by the Italian physiotherapist Luigi Stecco. The method is based on precise mapping of points in the fascia, and treating them releases adhesions and restores the tissues' ability to glide. In this way it affects pain and function even in places far from the treated point. I have studied every level of the method, in Israel and in Italy, and it is one of the two main tools in my clinic.
PFFM, Pelvic Floor Fascial Mobilization,: PFFM, Pelvic Floor Fascial Mobilization, is the extension I developed of Fascial Manipulation® into the pelvic floor: internal manual treatment of the fascial tissues of the pelvic floor, based on a map of internal treatment points. I have published two scientific articles on the method. The full page on PFFM.
שיטה צרפתית לשיקום הבטן ורצפת האגן באמצע: A French method for rehabilitating the abdomen and pelvic floor through exhalation, with the WINNERFLOW exhaler. The second main tool in my clinic, which I have taught in Israel since 2013. The full page on the Guillarme method.
דיקור יבש הוא טיפול במחטים דקות במיוחד,: Dry needling is a treatment with very fine needles, without injecting any substance (hence the name "dry"), for pain and muscle dysfunction. It is a Western medicine technique, completely different from Chinese acupuncture, and it is given according to a physiotherapy diagnosis. The needle is aimed at trigger points in the muscle, and helps release them, reduce pain and speed up healing.
קינזיוטייפ הוא סרט כותנה אלסטי שמודבק על: Kinesio tape is an elastic cotton tape stuck onto the skin, which has a gentle, lasting effect on the soft tissues beneath it. The immediate effects: less pain, better fluid drainage and blood flow, and relief for the muscles, tendons and ligaments in the injured area. The direction of application, the shape of the cut, the tension of the tape and how long it stays on the skin all matter a great deal, and combining exercises with the tape brings quick improvement in many of the problems.
